workflows.goal: Monitor activation and acquisition movement across the growth dashboard and its driver query.

card.title: Growth pulse
card.what_to_watch: Activation and acquisition movement across the growth dashboard and driver query.
card.why_watch: Growth leadership should hear about a meaningful, corroborated change without checking dashboards every morning.
watch_for: The driver query corroborates the movement
questions: Is this a meaningful change rather than ordinary variation?
card.decision_guidance: Ignore ordinary variation. Notify Growth when activation movement is large and corroborated by the driver query. Investigate when movement is meaningful but evidence is incomplete. Do not notify when a required source is stale or failed.

delivery.label: Growth leadership
delivery.instructions: Send the evidence bundle and the first investigation question.

workflows.goal: Only watch the Growth overview dashboard for meaningful activation movement and distinguish normal weekly variation from an alert; do not recommend related driver queries for this card.

card.title: Growth normal variation
card.what_to_watch: Activation movement and its weekly variance.
card.why_watch: Avoid noisy push notifications for changes that are inside the agreed operating range.
watch_for: Activation moves outside the normal operating range
card.decision_guidance: Ignore movement inside the normal operating range of plus or minus 5 percent. Investigate movement outside that range when no corroborating source is present. Do not notify from this card.

delivery.label: Growth analyst
delivery.instructions: Ask the analyst to inspect the next available cohort breakdown.

workflows.goal: Monitor the liquidity dashboard and settlement pipeline for a meaningful liquidity movement that Finance should review.

card.title: Liquidity pulse
card.what_to_watch: Liquidity movement and settlement pipeline health.
card.why_watch: Finance needs a trustworthy signal and should not be alerted from a stale settlement feed.
watch_for: Settlement pipeline is healthy enough to trust
questions: Is the movement actionable or a pipeline artifact?
card.decision_guidance: Ignore movement inside 1 percent when settlement is healthy. Notify Finance when liquidity moves beyond 5 percent and settlement is healthy. Use insufficient_data when settlement is stale or failed. Do not infer a safe action from the dashboard alone.

delivery.label: Finance control
delivery.instructions: Send the liquidity evidence and settlement freshness.

workflows.goal: When marketplace conversion moves, connect the Hex review, governed dbt metric, and latency query to decide what the product team should investigate.

card.title: Marketplace diagnosis
card.what_to_watch: Marketplace conversion movement and its product or latency drivers.
card.why_watch: Product leadership needs a compact evidence bundle that points to the next investigation instead of reading three systems.
watch_for: A related driver can explain the movement
questions: Is this a product problem or a latency problem?
Which source should Product inspect first?
card.decision_guidance: Investigate when conversion moves more than 10 percent or when the evidence conflicts. Do not notify automatically from this card. The result must identify the strongest evidence source and its limitations.

delivery.label: Product operations
delivery.instructions: Open the evidence bundle and assign the first investigation.

workflows.goal: Monitor commerce revenue across the dashboard, Trino freshness query, and Airflow load to decide whether Finance should be notified.

card.title: Commerce quality
card.what_to_watch: Commerce revenue movement and the freshness of its warehouse inputs.
card.why_watch: Finance should receive pushed analytics only when the revenue signal is both meaningful and trustworthy.
watch_for: Warehouse freshness supports trusting the movement
questions: Is the revenue change real enough to act on?
card.decision_guidance: Ignore ordinary movement below 3 percent. Notify Finance for a revenue movement above 8 percent when Trino and Airflow are healthy. Use insufficient_data when either quality source is stale or failed. Do not notify from a dashboard without its quality evidence.

delivery.label: Finance operations
delivery.instructions: Send revenue, freshness, and the first validation action.
